description: renewDomain: Stage renewal of a domain for a specified number of years. Deducts from account balance. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to renew, like "example.com", without scheme.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: renewDomain
